lines.text: Hi, can you help with the book sale? I have more books than I thought.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. Are the books ready to move, or do they still need price tags?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: The prices are on the books. I just need two strong boxes to carry them.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: There are two boxes under my desk. One is small, and one is quite big.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Are you talking about the desk near the window? I cannot see any boxes there.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: No, my desk is next to the back door. I am taking the small box at five.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Okay, I will pick up both at four. I can bring the small one back before five.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Thanks. Leave the small one on my chair when you bring it back.
lines.speaker: Eli
